question.text: Which of the following solutions will turn violet when a drop of lime juice is added to it?

options.text: A solution mixture of Nal and KI

solution.text:
When drop of line juice is added to mixture of $\mathrm{I}+\mathrm{IO}_{3}^{-}$. The following reaction take place and violet colour appears due to formation of $\mathrm{I}_{2}$
$\mathrm{I}+\mathrm{IO}_{3}^{-}+\mathrm{H}^{+} \longrightarrow \mathrm{I}_{2}+\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}$
